operations.description: Conditional Plan B: if full swap must remain, inventory services on PARTUUID 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111, migrate/clean data, check filesystem offline, shrink ext4 first, then reduce its GPT extent without changing its starting sector and reserve aligned Host space

Conditional Plan A: after user accepts reduced/removed disk swap and no hibernation requirement is proven, repartition approved PARTUUID 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111113 space for a 21474836480-byte Host root plus feasible retained swap
Conditional Plan A: update Manjaro fstab, all resume references and initramfs consistently; verify native boot and hibernation policy from recovery media

After one layout alternative is approved, use a separate \EFI\ElasticPC\ directory and independent boot entry; preserve all existing Windows/Manjaro entries and files, including entries absent from BootOrder

preconditions.detail: Requested Host root capacity: 21474836480 bytes; final image, swap, alignment and EFI overhead require separate measurement
Filesystem free space (including df output) is not unallocated GPT space; only a verified sector layout can admit a new partition
Verify independent full data backup, GPT/ESP backups, a Live recovery medium, and native Windows/Manjaro boot before any physical change
Choose exactly one mutually exclusive layout alternative and approve its final sector ranges; this combined review plan cannot be applied
For /dev/disk/by-id/nvme-YMTC_REDACTED, verify GPT GUID, logical sector size, exact start/end sectors, alignment and contiguous free extents
For /dev/disk/by-id/nvme-YMTC_REDACTED, unallocated capacity is unknown; no capacity is inferred from filesystem free space or rounded partition sizes
PARTUUID 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111111: shrink ext4 only from a Live/offline environment while unmounted; perform filesystem checks and measure minimum size plus operating headroom
Measure real ext4 used/minimum size, metadata and future operating headroom; clean/transfer data before approving exact filesystem and partition sizes
PARTUUID 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111113: swap region is 30386893619 bytes; Host root needs 21474836480 bytes before alignment and any retained swap
Check fstab, current and configured kernel resume/resume_offset arguments, initramfs, bootloader profiles and hibernation use; absence from the current command line alone is insufficient
PARTUUID 11111111-1111-1111-1111-111111111113 must be inactive and unheld in the approved offline environment; revalidate swap state before editing
Measure actual Host boot-file requirements and ESP free bytes; a nominal ESP size cannot prove capacity, and a separate Host ESP may be necessary

rollback: Use the verified recovery medium and independent backups; restoring GPT alone does not restore an already-shrunk or overwritten filesystem
Restore approved filesystem/data and boot metadata together with the matching partition map; verify both native operating systems independently
Remove only ElasticPC-owned files/entry after verification; preserve original native boot entries and default order
